Environmental, Social and Governance (ESG)

All relevant ESG related data and information, conveniently assembled in one place.

#ESG

The documents provided below are intended primarily for the information of investors, analysts, rating agencies and other capital market participants. They reflect the respective state of knowledge, planning and reporting as of the date of their publication. Actual circumstances, as well as the regulatory and legal framework, may have changed since publication. For current information and objectives, reference should be made to the most recently published documents and disclosures of the Volkswagen Group.

ESG Factbook & PAI Scorecard

To the ESG Factbook

The ESG Factbook is based on the Annual Report and Sustainability Report and also addresses topics such as “Just Transition.” In addition, it includes information from corporate policies, official websites, and other relevant governance documents.

Download PAI scorecard - Principal Adverse Impact indicators (according to SFRD)

Reporting

Volkswagen AG issues a consolidated non-financial statement (Sustainability Report) for the Volkswagen Group and Volkswagen AG for the 2025 reporting year.

To the reports

Sustainability in the Supply Chain

The Volkswagen Group provides information on this page about its human rights and environmental due diligence responsibilities and the processes in place to support their implementation.

Read more

Policies

The Volkswagen Group provides information on the principles and processes that support transparent and responsible corporate governance.

Read more

Memberships

The Volkswagen Group participates in global, national and topic-specific sustainability networks and initiatives at various levels and through a range of projects.

Read more

Corporate Governance

Corporate governance describes the framework of principles, responsibilities and processes for the management and oversight of the company, with a focus on long-term value creation.

Read more

ESG - Ratings and Scores

Some ESG ratings are actively managed by us, while other agencies are supplied with data only.

Read more

ESG Controversies

Current company statements on ESG controversies as well as insights into how ongoing developments are being handled.

Read more

Green Finance

The Green Finance approach supports the financing of selected projects that fall within the environmental categories defined in the Green Finance Framework.

Read more

Ethik, Risikomanagement & Compliance

Integrity and compliance are fundamental to lawful and values-based conduct. We are committed to the principles of the Universal Declaration of Human Rights, the ILO Core Labour Standards and the UN Guiding Principles on Business and Human Rights. In addition, this section provides information on our implementation of the German Supply Chain Due Diligence Act (LkSG), as well as on anti-corruption, risk management and our internal control system.

Read more

ESG-Conference

The annual ESG conference provides capital market participants with concise insights into current sustainability topics and the company's ESG activities.

The specified fuel consumption and emission data does not refer to a single vehicle and is not part of the offer but is only intended for comparison between different types of vehicles. Additional equipment and accessories (additional components, tyre formats, etc.) can alter relevant vehicle parameters such as weight, rolling resistance and aerodynamics, affecting the vehicle's fuel consumption, power consumption, CO₂ emissions and driving performance values in addition to weather and traffic conditions and individual driving behavior. Further information on official fuel consumption data and official specific CO₂ emissions for new passenger cars can be found in the "Guide to fuel economy, CO₂ emissions and power consumption for new passenger car models", which is available free of charge from all sales dealerships and from DAT Deutsche Automobil Treuhand GmbH, Hellmuth-Hirth-Str. 1, D-73760 Ostfildern, Germany and at www.dat.de/co2.
